_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); railroad signals

pit_profile.why: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not

classification.quality_note: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 3.70x; +55% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.85; conservative 2yr +2%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -6.8%/yr (worst year FY16-FY25, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +15.8%/yr (Q2 2026 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +15.8%/yr (FY16-FY25 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +24.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY16-FY25); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: UNP (retrospective, 2026-08-28) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 3.70x (40.5% downside to Bear $183 / +10.9% upside to Bull $341) | Adj composite 3.05 vs market 3.90: gap -0.85 [OVERVALUED] | +55% above the EPP floor $198 (17x FY26E $11.66) | Conservative 2-yr case: +2.0% total (+1.0%/yr) | At 26.4x FY26E the 15% hurdle price $407 sits above the BULL case; carloads +2% in Q2 2026, forward revenue +12% (no FY26 revenue guide, Q2 2026 freight revenue); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
